item.title: Non‐Precious Metal High‐Entropy Oxide Sub‐1 nm Nanowires for Li‐O 2 Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a general POM-induced synthesis of non-precious metal high-entropy oxide sub-1 nm nanowires, guided by MD simulations revealing Coulomb and van der Waals driving forces. Significance: ultrafine 1D structure exposes active sites, tunable components optimize LiO2*/Li2O2 adsorption, and oxide-POM interactions enhance stability, enabling 9944 mAh g−1 capacity and 312-cycle durability in Li-O2 batteries.
🏷 Li-O2 battery · high-entropy oxide · nanowires · polyoxometalate · cathode catalyst

item.title: Topological Superlattice Stabilized Layered Oxide Cathodes With Sustainable Anionic Redox
item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a topological superlattice strategy creating a Li/Mg/Ni triple-center honeycomb superlattice, which activates reversible oxygen anionic redox while suppressing phase transitions and cation migration. This yields a high-capacity (242 mAh g⁻¹), stable sodium-ion cathode (91.8% retention after 100 cycles), offering new design principles for sustainable, high-energy batteries.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · layered oxide cathode · anionic redox · superlattice · phase transition

💡 The novelty lies in using charge dynamics to guide polymer structural engineering, overcoming the Tg–capacitive trade-off that limits high-temperature polymer dielectrics. 💡 The novelty lies in using nitrogen-directed semi-ionic C-F bonding to engineer a LiF-rich interphase on graphite anodes. This addresses the interfacial Li+ transport bottleneck limiting fast charging. item.title: Boosting Oxygen Transport with Nanoporous Graphdiyne for High‐Capacity Li−O 2 Batteries
item.description:
افزودن گرافدایین نانوحفره‌دار به کاتد، انتقال O2 را تسریع کرده و ظرفیت دشارژ باتری Li-O2 را بیش از چهار برابر به 10.36 mAh cm−2 افزایش می‌دهد.
Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Introducing nanoporous graphdiyne into carbon-black cathodes creates low-resistance O₂ diffusion pathways, boosting Li−O₂ discharge capacity over 4× to 10.36 mAh cm⁻² (950 mAh g⁻¹). This enables deeper O₂ penetration, altering Li₂O₂ growth into larger particles throughout the cathode. The strategy advances mass transport engineering for high-energy-density Li−O₂ batteries.
🏷 Li-O2 battery · graphdiyne · oxygen transport · nanoporous cathode · discharge capacity

item.title: Regulating Sulfur Redox Microenvironment Through Phase Separation for High‐Energy‐Density Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries
item.description:
الکترود جدایش فازی با تخلخل کم‌پیچش، محیط ردوکس گوگرد را تنظیم کرده و باتری Li-S با بارگذاری بالای گوگرد و انرژی ۲۹۸ Wh/kg را ممکن می‌سازد.
Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in using phase separation to engineer low-tortuosity, electrolyte-accessible pores that regulate the sulfur redox microenvironment. This suppresses polarization and resistance evolution, enabling reversible sulfur conversion. Significance: achieves 13.5 mg cm⁻² sulfur loading, 14.6 mAh cm⁻² areal capacity at lean E/S 5 µL mg⁻¹, and a 298 Wh kg⁻¹ pouch cell under practical conditions.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · phase separation electrode · sulfur redox · lean electrolyte · pouch cell
